title: Living in a Shipping Container

image.attribution: Captain Albert E. Theberge, NOAA Corps (ret.) / Wikimedia Commons / Public Domain.

main_content:
Many people do not earn enough money to buy a house in the San Francisco Bay area. Housing prices in northern California can be very high.

So, some young people have begun making their own houses out of shipping containers. It takes a lot of work and creativity to make a home from the large metal boxes. And those who are doing it must often fight local laws that limit where such homes can be placed.

Heather Stewart is an artist. She and 19 other people live and work in a small community. Their neighborhood is made up of shipping containers and other kinds of small houses.

Heather Stewart and her friend Luke Iseman have been living in the community since April. Before then, they lived in Oakland, a city near San Francisco. But officials forced the two to remove their shipping container houses from a property they had bought with friends. Officials said they were violating local laws.
 So they moved to a large warehouse. They and their friends have placed more than 10 containers inside the building. Each container costs about $2,000. The group wants to keep the small community secret from local officials.

questions.question: Who is Heather Stewart?
options: A community organizer fighting housing laws
An artist living in a shipping container community
A city official regulating housing in San Francisco
A real estate agent in northern California
questions.answer: An artist living in a shipping container community

questions.question: Where is Heather Stewart’s shipping container house right now?
options: In a large warehouse with other containers
On a purchased property with friends
In a hidden location outside the city
questions.answer: In a large warehouse with other containers

questions.question: How are the housing prices in northern California?
options: Very high and unaffordable for many
questions.answer: Very high and unaffordable for many
